title: 第2037章 古祖都来了第2036章 动静消失的很快
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
第2037章古祖都来了！
李族共有六位老祖，动作全都非常快，第一时间冲了过去，护住被震飞的那位老祖。
‘噗噗噗’——
鲜血喷洒，被震飞的那位李族老祖，口吐鲜血不止，自身受到重创。
若非其他六位老祖护住了他，他站都站不稳！
序颜、离蜚等身后势力的老祖们，见到这一幕，脸色一个比一个凝重。
他们还说要替死去的序颜、离蜚等强者报仇。
但是此刻——
他们全都不敢轻举妄动！
这不是开玩笑的。
仅是一刀而已，就击碎了极负凶名的古矛，还将李族老祖震到重伤，丧失了再战能力。
这种情况下，他们哪里还敢轻举妄动！
那边可还有陈长生等在！
他们心情沉重无比。
虽然他们很不想承认，但他们也不得不承认，他们大概率对付不了陈长生等！
其他古老势力的老祖，眼神不断地在火刀和陈长生等身上来回扫过。
他们神色也尽皆都凝重无比。
原因无它——
皆因陈长生等这么强，他们后面还怎么争抢这里的机缘与造化？！
这时，虚空扭动，恐怖气息疯狂蔓延。

一道又一道极其可怕的身影，从扭曲的虚空中走出，降临到这里。
他们不是别人，正是李飘冉、序颜、离蜚身后古老势力内的古祖！
此前他们一直都在观望，并未进入山脉深处，防止山脉深处有什么意外发生。
他们都想当山脉深处机缘造化现世时，他们再过来。
但现在——
他们全都坐不住了，一个个火速赶来，害怕他们这边的老祖出事，被陈长生等给斩杀掉！
“古祖现身了！”
“嘶…这可是不常见的存在！”
古祖级别的存在，这是站在云巅的古老人物，等闲之辈根本见不到。
甚至不说等闲之辈了，就算是古老势力内的教主与族长等，也不见得能见到古祖级别的存在。
古祖级别的存在，基本已经不怎么管事了，只在极其重要的时刻出现。
李族共有五位古祖。
content_en:
Chapter 2037 The ancient ancestors are here!
There were six ancestors of the Li clan, and they all moved very quickly. They rushed over immediately to protect the ancestor who was knocked away.
‘Puff puff puff’——
Blood sprayed out, and the ancestor of the Li clan who was knocked away was vomiting blood and suffered severe injuries.
If the other six ancestors hadn't protected him, he wouldn't have been able to stand firmly!
The ancestors of the forces behind them, such as Xu Yan and Li Fei, saw this scene, and their faces became more solemn.
They also said that they wanted to avenge the deaths of Xu Yan, Li Fei and other powerful people.
But at this moment——
None of them dared to act rashly!
This is no joke.
With just one strike, the infamous ancient spear was shattered, and the ancestor of the Li clan was severely injured, losing the ability to fight again.
Under such circumstances, how dare they act rashly!
There is Chen Changsheng waiting over there!
Their hearts are heavy.
Although they didn't want to admit it, they had to admit that there was a high probability that they wouldn't be able to deal with Chen Changsheng and others!
The ancestors of other ancient forces kept glancing back and forth at Huo Dao, Chen Changsheng and others.
Their expressions were all solemn.
There is no other reason——
Because Chen Changsheng and others are so strong, how can they compete for the opportunities and fortunes here? !
At this time, the void twisted and the terrifying aura spread crazily.
One after another, extremely terrifying figures walked out of the twisted void and landed here.
They are none other than the ancient ancestors of the ancient forces behind Li Piaoran, Xu Yan and Li Fei!
They had been waiting and watching before, not entering the depths of the mountains to prevent any accidents from happening deep in the mountains.
They all want to come back when opportunity arises deep in the mountains.
But now——
They all couldn't sit still and rushed over one by one, fearing that something would happen to their ancestors and they would be killed by Chen Changsheng and others!
"The ancient ancestor appears!"
"Hiss...this is an uncommon existence!"
An existence at the level of ancient ancestors, this is an ancient figure standing on the top of the clouds, which ordinary people cannot see at all.
Not even talking about ordinary people, even the sect leaders and clan leaders within the ancient forces may not be able to see existences at the level of ancient ancestors.
Existences at the level of ancient ancestors basically don't care much anymore and only appear at extremely important moments.
There are five ancient ancestors of the Li clan.
